newsitem.title: JAPAN: Abu Dhabi cuts term naphtha offer to $21-traders.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi cuts term naphtha offer to $21-traders.

text.p: In term naphtha talks between Abu Dhabi and Asian clients, Abu Dhabi National Oil Co (ADNOC) has cut its offer price to $21.00 per tonne over the ADNOC formula from the previous $21.75, traders said on Monday.

ADNOC originally offered a $22.50 premium for one-year term supply contracts starting in July, against initial bids at about $19.00 to $20.00 for paraffinic pentane-plus and full-range "low sulphur" naphtha.
Some buyers in the talks said they have yet to decide if they will raise their bids to meet ADNOC halfway.

The potential buyers--one South Korean petrochemical firm, three Japanese trading houses and one Japanese refiner--are expected to buy a total 500,000 to 700,000 tonnes of ADNOC naphtha in the new term year, traders said.
